subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hook names and payloads to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection proves the missing hook surface, but the permanent public plugin API shape and cross-channel semantics need maintainer product/API intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve generic observation hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for channel parity.

options.title: Scope to Discord first
options.body: Accept a Discord-first contract now, but require explicit follow-up criteria so cross-channel payload drift does not become permanent.

options.title: Defer the API surface
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events or external workarounds until maintainers are ready to sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve generic observation hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only public hooks with a shared payload, then wire Discord first with tests and docs while leaving room for channel parity.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin hook context work and review metadata make this the best available owner for the public hook-contract decision, with Discord input from `steipete` likely useful.
